Name: Doresuaan's Wizard M. Rasmodius Portraits
Author: Doresuaan
Description:
[color=#f1f1f1]A small Portrait Mod for the Wizard.

[/color][b][i][u][code]⚠️IMPORTANT: THIS MOD DOESN’T INCLUDE CHARACTER SPRITES! ONLY THE PORTRAITS.

For character sprites, you will need to use your own, the ones included in the mods you use or the Vanilla walking sprites.
Sorry, i shall make one but i assure you it will NOT be so soon!!!  :(

[/code][/u][/i][/b]
Contains 19 default expressions, 1 Pink Haired for SVE, and 12 beach portraits if you wish to use the 32 Expressions Set (For RRRR)!

Also includes an Alt with/without the Wizard Hat if you wish to change it…sadly no toggle though.
I will try creating a toggle option after im 100% done working with all Portrait Modes. ( When it is fully compatible wih RRRR. )

[u]There’s a set for each version, [i]please check the number of expressions you use before downloading!
[/i][/u][img]https://i.imgur.com/dkajmcB.png[/img]﻿

[b][u][size=4]Installation:
[/size]
[/u][/b]-Check which Portrait Mode you/your mods use! (2,7,9,12 or 32)
[b][u]* MAKE SURE TO CHECK OTHERWISE IT WILL ACT WEIRDLY IF YOU DOWNLOAD THE WRONG ONE![/u][/b]

-Download the correct one from the files page.
[i][u]*Don’t download all of them, only the one you want to use! Also, there’s Alternative Options for hats, make sure to check this too if you want with/without the hat.[/u]
[/i]
-Once download is done, locate it in your folders and unzip the mod.

-Then, copy the Mod folder ([CP] Doresuaan’s Wizard Portraits) into your StardewValley/Mods folder.

-Open the game and check if everything works.

-All done! Now you can play, enjoy! ✨



[b][size=5][u]Available Portraits Modes:[/u]
[/size][/b]
[b]2 Expressions (Vanilla)[/b]: Fully compatible! Just check the files for the Vanilla Edition.

[b]7 Expressions[/b]: May need to be edited in case any bugs are found, also fully compatible though, find it in the files! 

[b]9 Expressions[/b]: Also may need to be edited in case any bugs are found, find it in the files! 

[b]12 Expressions[/b]: Again, may need to be edited in case any bugs are found, also find it in the files! 

[b]32 Expressions (RRRR): [/b]Not exactly fully compatible because it’s unfinished, but can be used. Find in the files! Please keep in mind the hair and outfit mechanics [u]won’t work[/u] until i fully Release it.

[b]Let me know if you use a portrait sheet that has a different amount, so i can 100% add compatibility for it![/b]

[b][size=3]※What are the configs for?[/size][/b]
- Currently only to disable/enable the mod. I plan on making a toggle config for the hat when im 100% done with the Mod though.

[b][size=3]※My game has the Hat Alt, but i wanted it without! (Or vice-versa)[/size][/b]
- Make sure to check which Mod you added, if you want the hat, delete the folder with no “- Hat Alt” or do delete if you wish him to be without his hat.

[b][size=3]※Do i need other mods for it to work? (Portraiture, etc)[/size][/b]
- No! However, is recommended for you to use the recommended expression in case you have a Mod that also changes his Portraits.
[u]E.g:[/u] If you use RomRas, download the 9 Expression Mode one, if using SVE the 7,12 Expression Mode, and RRRR the 32 Expression Mode.

[b][size=3]※Why is it not fully compatible with RRRR?[/size][/b]
- Because it is a [u]Work in Progress.[/u] You can use it of course, there’s no problem with it! However, you won’t be able to fully experience all the Mod Potential. I am currently working on finishing all the Alternate Hairstyles and Seasonal Outfits, so i ask you to be patient!
But YES it is compatible, but you won’t have the full experience if you use the WIP one.

[b][size=3]※Why are there no Walking Sprites?[/size][/b]
- Because i’m lazy. /j 
Jokes aside, it is a ton of work and i’d need to individually make one for every single mod that uses it, and i honestly don’t believe in myself to do it… So for now, there’s no Walking Sprite, but you can use the one your mod provides or the Vanilla Sprite. It is not 100% accurate to the redesign i made of him, but works quite fine in my opinion!

[b][size=3]※Do i need SVE (Stardew Valley Expanded) for it to work?[/size][/b]
- Nope! You just need SMAPI and Content Patcher for the portraits to work.

[b][size=3]※Will you ever make Portraits for other characters too?[/size][/b]
- Who knows, maybe if i’m motivated enough, i just like Razzy a bit too much! <3

[b][size=3]※When wil RRRR be ready?
[/size][/b]- I’m not 100% sure, my progress on it varies on my mood and my routine! But so far, i have completed a few of the hair variations, which you can see as a sneak peek on the Media Tab and below.

[b][size=3]※What are the upcoming updates?[/size][/b]
- I plan on doing a Seasonal Outfit for each Portrait Mode! Not only for RRRR.
I also plan to make a Hat Toggle so it is easier to switch between images, even in-game as well. (Especially if you use GMCM)
